title: ELH Software Engineer / Agent Engineer - EDA - Austin 2027
description:
Introduction

The IBM Electronic Design Automation (EDA) team is seeking motivated early-career engineers with a passion for software engineering, AI, and semiconductor design. Our team develops advanced software and Agentic AI solutions that drive the design and verification of IBM's next-generation processors and computing systems — spanning logic design, verification, synthesis, routing, and timing analysis.

These positions are competitive. We encourage applications from candidates with demonstrated programming skills, a foundation in computer science, computer engineering, or electrical engineering, and a genuine interest in AI and advanced computing.

Your Role And Responsibilities

EDA is at the center of IBM's Agentic AI transformation in semiconductor development. As an EDA Software Engineer, you will work alongside experienced engineers to design, develop, and deploy innovative tools used across IBM zSystems, Power Systems, Storage, and Quantum Computing products.

Work You Could Be Doing

AI-Driven Automation: Develop and deploy Agentic AI and machine learning solutions that automate complex chip design workflows, including synthesis and place-and-route

Tool Development: Build and maintain software tools that support logic design, functional verification, timing analysis, and physical design

Algorithm Engineering: Design and implement efficient algorithms and large-scale software systems that improve design quality and accelerate chip development

Collaborative Innovation: Partner with hardware and software engineers across IBM to deliver solutions that shape the future of computing

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field
Experience with object-oriented programming languages such as C++, Java, Rust, or similar
Experience with Python or other scripting languages
Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and digital logic design
Coursework or project experience with AI or Agent Engineering
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to develop efficient algorithms and software solutions
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Ability to work effectively in collaborative, fast-paced engineering environments
Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn new technologie

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field
Knowledge of computer architecture and microarchitecture
Familiarity with digital, VLSI, or semiconductor design concepts
Experience with logic design, functional verification, synthesis, place-and-route, or timing analysis
Experience with GenAI, Agentic AI systems, ML frameworks, or AI-assisted software development
Experience developing software in Linux environments
Understanding of software engineering practices, testing methodologies, and version control systems
note: IBM EDA: relevant no, 'ELH Software Engineer / Agent Engineer' has no intern or co-op wording anywhere and the description is 'seeking motivated early-career engineers', so it is a regular job despite the in-scope agentic AI and tool-development work. degreeOk yes, 'BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering'. workAuth unclear, the posting says nothing about work authorisation.
